changed_interfaces.change: Removed the false public clause claiming that an upper semicontinuous function on a compact set need not be bounded below; retained the true claim that it need not attain its infimum.

dispositions.notes: Read in full. The consumer proves a bounded-below upper semicontinuous example whose infimum is not attained and uses only the unchanged theorem claim that upper semicontinuity on a nonempty compact set forces a maximum. Its title, Statement refuted, Counterexample, L5, step 4.1, and both Remarks agree with the repaired public Statement. No consumer edit or rejudge is required.
